Decision Makers Guide
Amended Chapters for June 2020 - Summary of changes

Volume 13: State Pension Credit

Chapter 77: Conditions of entitlement, membership of the
household and normal amount payable
Amendment made to the definition of a couple at 77013, and legal ref following SI
2019/1458; ‘Note’ added to 77035 to provide clarity.


Chapter 78: State Pension Credit: additional amounts and special
groups
Memo DMG 02/20 incorporated – ‘Note’ added at 78030 and 78105; Memo DMG
16/18 incorporated at 78521; Up-rating Memo DMG 05/20 incorporated at Appendix
1; Memo DMG 08/20 incorporated at Appendix 2 – parental bereavement leave;
Appendix 2 amended to properly reflect that of Appendix 2 in Chapter 44.




Please note that DMG volume amendment packages (‘remove & insert pages’) are
no longer produced. This summary of changes document does, however, inform the
user of the significant changes that have taken place in each amended chapter by
volume. Page footers continue to show the volume, amendment number and date.
